description: This Java class defines configuration properties for a request/response client in the Eclipse Hono framework. It extends a base configuration class and manages cache size and timeout settings with default values and validation.

classes.name: RequestResponseClientConfigProperties
classes.description: A Java class that encapsulates configurable properties for the request/response client, including cache size and timeout settings with default values and validation.

methods.name: getResponseCacheMinSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the response cache.

methods.name: setResponseCacheMinSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum size of the response cache, with validation against negative values.

methods.name: getResponseCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the response cache.

methods.name: setResponseCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the response cache, with validation against negative values.

methods.name: getResponseCacheDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout period for cached responses.

methods.name: setResponseCacheDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout for cached responses, ensuring it is greater than zero.
